sequence_points.name: Landscape with Path and Autumn Trees
sequence_points.description: A landscape painting depicting a winding path through a wooded area with autumnal trees, rendered in soft earth tones and muted greens and yellows. The artwork is mounted on a wall, slightly angled, with visible brushwork suggesting an impressionistic style.

sequence_points.name: Abstract Landscape with Blue and Green Tones
sequence_points.description: A vertically oriented abstract painting featuring soft, blended hues of blue, green, and beige, suggesting a landscape or atmospheric scene. The artwork is mounted on a wall with a visible frame, displayed in a museum setting.
